findings.summary: classify_pointer receives the view's own record list as its pointer snapshot, but runs_view passes _live_records_for_run's single record and mcp_views narrows by project/phase/session before project_live_rows, so an in-flight hand-dispatched review is not recognised and the row prints a dispatch again.

review:
VERDICT goal: the work to review is the two commits after the prior review, and both findings it raised are addressed — reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:615-651 threads the caller's pointer snapshot and tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py:150-167 covers the queued/working/complete/failed phase edge — but reckon/crew/query.py:890 hands a narrowed snapshot to the recogniser, so the goal holds on the full live view and not on a single-run or filtered one.
VERDICT done_when: the source done-when names tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py and three cases; I read the file at 45ba80a6 and re-ran it (7 passed, EXIT=0, this run's review-gate.log), and the manifest's arms are real: base-arm.log '132 passed … EXIT=0' at 7982557bec, head-arm-2.log '7 passed … EXIT=0' at a6506a7f84.
VERDICT write_paths: declared are reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, reckon/crew/query.py, tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py, the fragment and a figures directory; every path in git diff 0a750cc551..45ba80a6d3 is one of the first four, and the figures directory is untouched.
VERDICT manifest: read at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261102T215409121985-a-starting-review-is-visible/manifest.md; it reads status complete, four commits, both suite arms with log paths, both negative controls and seven rubric lines.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against base 0a750cc551b0aa5180d5e10f8f767b99ab59e9ab; a6506a7f84 adds the `pointers` keyword to classify_pointer (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:715) and _review_run_in_flight (:615) and passes it from query.py:427 and :890, with the phase and read-count cases in the test; 45ba80a6d3 updates only the evidence fragment to report seven cases.
CALL_SITES: reckon/mcp_views.py:4250 (project_live_rows, now snapshot-fed), reckon/crew/query.py:890 (runs_view), reckon/crew/obligations.py:638, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:312, reckon/crew/directory.py:97, reckon/crew/promotion.py:387, reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:698 (stand-alone classify_pointer callers passing no snapshot)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 15
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the snapshot is handed from reckon/crew/query.py:890 as run_view's own live_records, which _live_records_for_run (query.py:761) reduces to the one subject pointer, so a review in flight under a single-run read is not found.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the manifest's base arm reckons/crew runs 132 passed at 7982557bec and the head arm 7 passed at a6506a7f84, both with EXIT=0, and I re-ran the head-arm test file at 45ba80a6 to 7 passed.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the two commits touch only reckon/crew/query.py, reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-starting-review-is-visible.html, all declared.
SCORE durability: 15
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py:150 reddens when the terminal-phase exclusion in reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:612 is removed and :170 reddens when pointers= is dropped from query.py:427 — both shown red by negative-control.log and negative-control-pointers.log — but no case covers the single-run or filtered snapshot where the regression lives.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the added keyword and docstrings match the surrounding style of reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:602-651, the commit subjects carry bodies, and no name encodes a plan or ticket label.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change extends the existing recogniser in reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:527 (which already accepted `pointers`) rather than adding a second rule, and reuses _PRE_SPAWN_PHASES at recovery_classification.py:612.
FINDING reckon/crew/query.py:890 non-blocking: classify_pointer is now handed the view's own record list as its pointer snapshot, but runs_view supplies _live_records_for_run's single record (query.py:761-774 returns [record]) and mcp_views narrows live_records by project, phase and session before calling project_live_rows (reckon/mcp_views.py:4225-4250), so an in-flight review whose pointer is filtered out can no longer be recognised and the row prints `reckon crew dispatch` for a review that is already starting; reflex-composed reviews are still caught by the recorded-dispatch arm at recovery_classification.py:643, but hand-dispatched reviews regress on those surfaces and no test covers them.
